name: Caitlyn
title: The Sheriff of Piltover

passive.name: Headshot

description.normalized: Every 6 attacks fires a Headshot, dealing 27 (50% AD + 125 Critical chance) bonus physical damage. Trapped or netted enemies trigger a Headshot that has double range. Attacking from brush builds Headshot twice as fast.

passive.rawParsedText:

Attacking from brush builds Headshot twice as fast.

q.name: Piltover Peacemaker

description.normalized: Fires a narrow piercing bullet that deals 60 / 110 / 160 / 210 (+ 125% / 140% / 155% / 170% AD) physical damage. Hitting an enemy expands the bullet, but reduces subsequent damage by 40%. Always deals full damage to trapped or netted enemies.

q.rawParsedText: Fires a narrow piercing bullet that deals 60 / 110 / 160 / 210 (+ 125% / 140% / 155% / 170% AD) physical damage. Hitting an enemy expands the bullet, but reduces subsequent damage by 40%. Always deals full damage to trapped or netted enemies.

w.name: Yordle Snap Trap

description.normalized: Sets a trap that enemy champions can spring, immobilizing them for 1.5 seconds and Revealing them for a short duration. Traps last for 30 seconds and 2 / 3 / 4 / 5 can be active at once. Trap charging time: 27 / 22 / 17 / 12 seconds.

e.name: 90 Caliber Net

description.normalized: Launchest a net, knocking Caitly backwards. The net deals 70 / 120 / 170 / 220 (+80% AP) magic damage and slows by 50% for 1.5 seconds.

r.name: Ace in the Hole

description.normalized: Lines up the perfect shot, Revealing an enemy champion for 1.5 seconds before dealing 200 / 375 / 550 (+200% bonus AD) physical damage plus 20% of their missing Health. Enemy champions can intercept the bullet before it hits their ally.
